schema_metadata.schema_name: PE Buyout Permission, Authority and Governance Model
schema_metadata.purpose: Contextual roles, object permissions, authority actions, gate bindings, delegation, conflicts, segregation, and immutable governance records.

principles: Permission and authority are distinct and independently evaluated.
Ownership, preparation, recommendation, approval, capital authorization, and funding execution are distinct responsibilities.
Approval, waiver, override, risk acceptance, and capital action are never inferred from silence, circulation, attendance, or elapsed time.
Every authority action produces an immutable record referencing the effective rule, role assignment, permission evaluations, evidence basis, conditions, conflicts, and expiry.
Delegation is explicit, scoped, time-bound, revocable, and prohibited for configured non-delegable actions.
Conflict recusal recalculates quorum; a conflicted actor cannot approve an exception to the actor’s own conflict.
System administration cannot confer investment authority.

roles.conflict_constraints: Conflicts are evaluated at organization and representative level.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Organization role does not itself identify an authorized natural person.

roles.conflict_constraints: Must disclose conflicts and may be recused.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Cannot approve own recommendation, exception, or capital action.

roles.abstract_definition: The actor accountable for completeness, quality, lineage, and status of a specific workstream run.
roles.role_scope: Workstream run within a deal.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S10_MONITORING; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION

roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; challenge; resolve; share_internally
roles.delegation_eligibility: May delegate preparation tasks but not final accountability unless reassigned.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot accept a material unresolved issue produced by the same workstream without independent authority.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Preparer and approving authority remain distinct for material conclusions.

roles.abstract_definition: A scoped contributor who prepares evidence, analysis, or findings for a workstream owner.
roles.role_scope: Workstream run.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S10_MONITORING; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION

roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; challenge
roles.delegation_eligibility: Preparation tasks may be delegated.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot resolve material questions or approve final outputs.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Contributor cannot approve an object they prepared.

roles.abstract_definition: The actor accountable for coordinating the deal, workstream coverage, escalation, and recommendation readiness.
roles.role_scope: Deal scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S13_CLOSED_ARCHIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; SX_TERMINATED_STALLED_DECLINED; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S10_MONITORING; S1_ACCESS_CLEARANCE; S2_CASE_INGESTION; S3_SCREENING_ASSESSMENT; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION; S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S0_INTAKE; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE

roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; challenge; resolve; share_internally; archive
roles.delegation_eligibility: Operational coordination may be delegated; accountability remains explicit.
roles.conflict_constraints: Must recuse from authority actions when conflicted.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Deal coordination and final capital authority are distinct.

roles.abstract_definition: A member of the collective authority body that evaluates recommendations and exercises configured investment authority.
roles.role_scope: Decision and outcome actions for a deal.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S3_SCREENING_ASSESSMENT; S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; comment; challenge
roles.possible_authority_types: approve; reject; defer; condition; accept_risk; sell; impair; write_off; approve_follow_on
roles.delegation_eligibility: Delegation is governed by the authority rule and may be prohibited for collective votes.
roles.conflict_constraints: Conflicted members must recuse; quorum is recalculated.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: May not edit underlying evidence or models solely because of approval authority.

roles.abstract_definition: The actor accountable for running the authority process, confirming quorum, recording outcome, and ensuring conditions are explicit.
roles.role_scope: Authority action scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S3_SCREENING_ASSESSMENT; S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; comment
roles.delegation_eligibility: Substitution must be explicit and time-bounded.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot disregard recusal or manufacture quorum.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Chair records authority exercise but does not gain unilateral capital authority unless the rule says so.

roles.abstract_definition: An actor or collective body authorized under a configured rule to commit, increase, release, reduce, or realize capital.
roles.role_scope: Vehicle, deal, capital event, and exposure scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use
roles.possible_authority_types: commit_capital; release_funds; approve_follow_on; approve_restructuring; sell; impair; write_off
roles.delegation_eligibility: Delegation is only permitted if the authority rule expressly permits it.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot approve a capital action prepared solely by the same actor without independent review when segregation is required.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Funding operations and capital authorization are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: The actor responsible for analytical-model integrity, assumption lineage, versioning, and recomputation.
roles.role_scope: Analytical model and model-case scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; S10_MONITORING; S11_REUNDERWRITING
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence
roles.delegation_eligibility: Preparation may be delegated; identity of owner remains recorded.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot approve their own decision-ready model where independent review is required.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Model ownership and model approval are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: An independent reviewer authorized to sign off analytical logic, consistency, and decision readiness without investment authority.
roles.role_scope: Analytical model, model case, and valuation case scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; S11_REUNDERWRITING
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; comment; challenge
roles.delegation_eligibility: May be delegated only to a qualified independent reviewer.
roles.conflict_constraints: Must not be the sole preparer of the reviewed version.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Analytical sign-off does not authorize investment or capital.

roles.abstract_definition: A qualified reviewer accountable for legal authority, enforceability, liabilities, conditions, and document consistency.
roles.role_scope: Legal workstream and transaction-document scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; challenge; resolve
roles.delegation_eligibility: Technical work may be delegated; final legal conclusion requires qualified sign-off.
roles.conflict_constraints: Business authority may accept economic risk but cannot deem a legal condition satisfied without legal evidence.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Legal technical sign-off and investment risk acceptance are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: A qualified reviewer accountable for technical tax treatment, leakage, obligations, structure, and tax-sensitive economics.
roles.role_scope: Tax workstream and structure scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; challenge; resolve
roles.delegation_eligibility: Technical work may be delegated to qualified contributors.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot unilaterally accept investment risk or commit capital.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Technical tax conclusion and economic risk acceptance are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: The actor responsible for funds-flow preparation, banking validation, capital-event execution, and ledger reconciliation.
roles.role_scope: Vehicle, closing, capital event, and position scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION; S13_CLOSED_ARCHIVE
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence
roles.delegation_eligibility: Operational tasks may be delegated within controlled scope.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot authorize the capital commitment or release they execute.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Authorization, execution, and reconciliation require separate accountable steps.

roles.abstract_definition: An independent reviewer of materiality, policy adherence, conflicts, residual risk, and governance records.
roles.role_scope: Deal, workstream, gate, and authority scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S13_CLOSED_ARCHIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; SX_TERMINATED_STALLED_DECLINED; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S10_MONITORING; S1_ACCESS_CLEARANCE; S2_CASE_INGESTION; S3_SCREENING_ASSESSMENT; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION; S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S0_INTAKE; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; comment; challenge
roles.delegation_eligibility: May delegate evidence gathering but not independent review accountability.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot approve their own exception or resolve their own conflict.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Risk review and investment authority are distinct unless explicitly combined by rule.

roles.abstract_definition: A governance participant with rights to receive, observe, or contribute to post-close governance information as defined by contractual rights.
roles.role_scope: Company governance and portfolio monitoring scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S10_MONITORING; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; comment
roles.delegation_eligibility: Delegation follows the underlying governance right.
roles.conflict_constraints: Observer status does not imply voting or investment authority.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Board access and internal capital authority are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: An external professional assigned a limited workstream or transaction scope under confidentiality and access constraints.
roles.role_scope: Assigned deal, workstream, document, or agreement scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S1_ACCESS_CLEARANCE; S2_CASE_INGESTION; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION

roles.delegation_eligibility: Subcontracting requires explicit permission and scope.
roles.conflict_constraints: No internal investment authority unless separately assigned under a valid rule.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Advisory opinion and internal approval are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: An external counterparty representative permitted to provide source materials and respond to scoped questions.
roles.role_scope: Counterparty, source-material, and agreement scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S1_ACCESS_CLEARANCE; S2_CASE_INGESTION; S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION
roles.default_permission_capabilities: view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; disclose_externally
roles.delegation_eligibility: Authority derives from the represented organization and transaction documents.
roles.conflict_constraints: Cannot access internal challenge, decision, or governance records absent explicit policy.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Counterparty representation does not confer internal approval authority.

roles.abstract_definition: An external financing participant with scoped access, consent, and contractual authority.
roles.role_scope: Financing, agreement, covenant, and closing scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S10_MONITORING; S11_REUNDERWRITING
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use; create; edit; comment; attach_evidence; disclose_externally
roles.delegation_eligibility: Delegation follows financing documents and authorized representatives.
roles.conflict_constraints: Internal investment authority remains separate.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Contractual consent and internal capital approval are separate.

roles.abstract_definition: A technical administrator permitted to configure identity, policy, and system controls without investment authority.
roles.role_scope: Global or configured technical scope.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S13_CLOSED_ARCHIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; SX_TERMINATED_STALLED_DECLINED; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S10_MONITORING; S1_ACCESS_CLEARANCE; S2_CASE_INGESTION; S3_SCREENING_ASSESSMENT; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION; S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S0_INTAKE; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE
roles.default_permission_capabilities: administer_policy; administer_identity; archive; technical_audit
roles.delegation_eligibility: Technical duties may be delegated with expiry and logging.
roles.conflict_constraints: No content access or authority is implied by administrative capability.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Must not grant themselves investment authority or bypass policy evaluation.

roles.abstract_definition: An actor temporarily authorized to exercise a precisely scoped authority action under a valid delegation.
roles.role_scope: Specific action, object, threshold, and time window.
roles.lifecycle_stage_scope: S7_INVESTMENT_DECISION; S11_REUNDERWRITING; S13_CLOSED_ARCHIVE; S6_UNDERWRITING_VALUATION; SX_TERMINATED_STALLED_DECLINED; S9_CLOSING_ADMINISTRATION; S10_MONITORING; S1_ACCESS_CLEARANCE; S2_CASE_INGESTION; S3_SCREENING_ASSESSMENT; S12_EXIT_REALIZATION; S4_QUESTION_PLANNING; S8_EXECUTION_DOCUMENTATION; S0_INTAKE; S5_DILIGENCE_ACTIVE
roles.default_permission_capabilities: discover; view; use
roles.delegation_eligibility: Cannot exceed scope, threshold, object, duration, or subdelegation rule.
roles.conflict_constraints: Conflicts and segregation constraints continue to apply.
roles.segregation_of_duties_constraints: Delegation does not merge preparer, approver, or administrator roles.

permission_policies.scope_rule: Deal-scoped discovery only after policy and active access evaluation.
permission_policies.lifecycle_condition: Any active lifecycle state in which the role assignment is effective.
permission_policies.confidentiality_condition: Object confidentiality and source restrictions must permit the action.
permission_policies.ownership_condition: Active contextual role assignment is required.
permission_policies.relationship_condition: Actor must be related to the deal, workstream, organization, agreement, or vehicle through an active role assignment.
permission_policies.inheritance_rule: A child object may inherit a stricter parent restriction; inheritance never creates authority.
permission_policies.delegation_rule: Delegated permission must be explicit, scoped, logged, and time-bounded.
permission_policies.expiry_rule: Expires with the earliest of role assignment, access grant, policy, delegation, or object-specific restriction.
permission_policies.audit_requirement: Create or retain a permission-policy evaluation audit event for sensitive actions.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Single screening authority or configured collective authority.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Required when the screen concludes proceed or exception-proceed.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Permitted only if the active authority rule allows delegation within threshold.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Conflicted preparer cannot be sole approver.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses when screening conditions, scope, or decision basis materially changes.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: A later screening decision creates a successor decision and approval record.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Gate remains open or deal is deferred/declined.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Single accountable decision owner with workstream-owner consultation.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Required when scope, cost, reliance, or omitted workstream is material.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Task delegation allowed; scope approval delegation is configured.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Workstream owner may recommend but cannot self-approve a material omission.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses when a material new question or risk changes scope.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor scope approval required.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Workstream activation is blocked or conditional.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Authority rule may require single or collective investment authority.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Only when the unresolved item is material and continuation is requested.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Generally non-delegable unless explicitly allowed.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Question owner cannot be sole accepting authority.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires on stated review date or when new evidence changes the risk.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: New evidence requires successor risk acceptance and approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Return to question planning or block the affected gate.

authority_actions.applicable_state_or_transition: Any material gate or decision; T026; T027
authority_actions.approval_structure: Collective or threshold-based investment authority.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Material risk is open, unmitigated, and continuation is proposed.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Only if authority rule permits; critical risks may be non-delegable.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Risk owner and preparer cannot be the sole approver.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires on configured date, trigger, or evidence change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Creates successor acceptance; prior acceptance remains immutable.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Block, condition, reopen, or terminate.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Independent analytical sign-off; investment authority adopts the basis separately.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Required for a decision-ready valuation and for material methodological overrides.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegable only to qualified independent reviewer.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Model owner cannot approve the same version they prepared.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses when model, input, methodology, structure, or security terms become stale.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor valuation approval linked to the prior version.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Valuation remains reviewed or draft, not decision-ready.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Recommendation sign-off by accountable deal owner; not capital authority.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Required before submission to the investment authority.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: May be reassigned; cannot be inferred from document circulation.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Recommendation owner cannot substitute for approving authority.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses if decision basis materially changes before decision.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Revised recommendation creates successor record.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Decision package remains draft.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Collective or configured threshold-based investment authority with quorum.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Applies to initial investment approval and material changes to approved economics.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation follows the authority rule; collective approval may be non-delegable.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Conflicted members recuse; quorum recalculated.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on conditions, long-stop date, material change, or stale basis.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor approval required for changed terms.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Reject, defer, condition, or return to analysis.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Collective or configured threshold-based authority.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Conditions must be explicit, owned, dated, and verifiable.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Same constraints as investment approval.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: No condition may be self-certified by its owner when independent evidence is required.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on condition deadline or material basis change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Condition satisfaction creates evidence; changed conditions require successor approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Return to diligence/valuation or terminate.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Decision owner records deferral under the applicable authority process.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Deferral must state missing information, owner, due date, and next review.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: May be delegated only if authority process permits.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: No silent deferral through inaction.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires at next review date; then a new decision action is required.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor decision record resolves or extends deferral.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: State remains active or enters stalled route under policy.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Screening authority or investment authority according to stage and threshold.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: No additional materiality threshold; authority class follows stage.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation depends on stage and authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Conflicted decision-makers recuse.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Effective immediately unless decision states otherwise.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Revival requires a successor decision and new gate authorization.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Move to terminated/declined state.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment/signing authority plus required legal sign-off.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Signed documents must be consistent with approved economics or have an authorized exception.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Signing delegation must be explicit and document-scoped.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Authorized signatory cannot waive internal approval requirements.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses at long-stop, material term change, or authority expiry.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Amended documents require renewed approval if material.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Signing blocked or returned to decisioning.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Applicable authority rule plus legal finding and risk acceptance where material.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Only for waivable conditions; non-waivable legal requirements cannot be overridden.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Generally non-delegable for material conditions.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Condition owner cannot self-approve waiver.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires at signing or specified deadline.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Any extension or scope change creates successor exception.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Signing remains blocked or transaction is abandoned.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Closing authority with legal and funding readiness confirmations.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: All non-waived conditions, documents, funds flow, and authority records must be effective.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: May be delegated to designated closing authority if allowed.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Closing operator and capital authorizer remain distinct.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses at long-stop or material change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Failed/partial closing requires successor approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Closing blocked, delayed, remediated, or cancelled.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Applicable authority rule plus required technical sign-offs.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Only waivable conditions; material waiver requires risk acceptance.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Material waiver generally non-delegable.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Condition owner cannot self-waive.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires at closing or specified date.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor exception required for extension.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Closing remains blocked or fails.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Single or collective authority according to vehicle, amount, and action.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Threshold and vehicle rules are configurable.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Only if expressly permitted by authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Funding operator cannot authorize the commitment they execute.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on amount, timing, term, or vehicle change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Additional or revised commitment requires successor approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: No capital event may become authorized.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Dual control: valid capital authority plus funding-operator execution.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Requires effective commitment, closing readiness, verified instructions, and funds-flow match.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Execution may be delegated; authorization may not be implied.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Authorizer and executor must be separate where policy requires.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires at payment cut-off or instruction change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Changed instructions require renewed release approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Funds remain unreleased; closing delayed.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment and capital authority under configured threshold.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Requires separate old-money and new-money analysis and material risk disposition.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation follows authority rule; distressed actions may require elevated authority.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Existing exposure does not justify self-approval or sunk-cost bias.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on terms, liquidity need, or trigger change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Changed terms require successor decision.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Return to re-underwriting, restructure, sell, impair, or no action.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment authority plus legal, tax, financing, and structure sign-offs as applicable.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Materiality determined by economics, rights, exposure, and risk.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation follows authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Technical reviewers cannot substitute for investment authority.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on material term or counterparty change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor restructuring decision required.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Return to re-underwriting or terminate.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment authority with valuation and position-control evidence.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Threshold and accounting-control requirements are configurable.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation only if expressly allowed.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Model preparer cannot be sole approving authority.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Effective at stated date; later revision creates successor record.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Revised valuation or outcome creates successor decision.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Position remains unreconciled or previous mark remains effective.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment authority with execution and closing confirmations.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Materiality includes price, terms, certainty, residual rights, costs, and risk of waiting.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation follows sell authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Deal team recommendation is not sale authority.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on price, terms, buyer, residual exposure, or timing change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Changed exit terms require successor approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Hold, reunderwrite, or failed-exit route.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment authority with explicit residual-exposure treatment.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Requires quantified residual exposure and monitoring plan.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation follows sell authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: No actor may treat partial realization as full closure.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Lapses on quantity, price, or residual terms change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor approval required for changed partial exit.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Return residual position to monitoring.

authority_actions.approval_structure: Investment authority confirms treatment and monitoring/closure status.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Any non-zero or contingent exposure requires explicit disposition.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation follows authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Closing/archive operator cannot silently extinguish exposure.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Review date required if exposure remains live or contingent.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Successor outcome record updates treatment.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Return to monitoring or block archive.

authority_actions.applicable_state_or_transition: Any state or transition with a failed/blocked gate
authority_actions.approval_structure: Override authority specified by the applicable authority rule; may require collective approval.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Requires explicit materiality assessment, evidence, scope, expiry, and residual-risk statement.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Only if the rule allows; legal or external conditions may be non-overridable.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Requester, blocker owner, and approver must satisfy segregation rules.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Expires at stated date, condition, or evidence change.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: New override requires successor exception and approval.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Gate remains blocked or process terminates.

authority_actions.authority_action: Revive a terminated or stalled process
authority_actions.approval_structure: Screening authority or investment authority based on prior stage and requested route.
authority_actions.materiality_condition: Requires stated new evidence, changed circumstance, or new process basis.
authority_actions.delegation_rule: Delegation depends on screening authority rule.
authority_actions.conflict_rule: Original decision remains immutable and conflicted actors recuse.
authority_actions.expiry_or_lapse_rule: Revival authorization expires if no transition occurs by configured date.
authority_actions.supersession_rule: Later revival creates successor record.
authority_actions.failure_behavior: Process remains terminated/stalled/declined.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: Use eligible substitute only if rule permits.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: approve own finding; accept own unresolved question; approve own model; approve own exception
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: The same actor prepared or owns the subject and independent review is required.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Preparer is sole approver or risk-acceptance authority.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: Only where authority rule explicitly permits single-person control for immaterial action; record exception.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: Output is material to a gate or decision.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: The sole preparer provides the only effective approval.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.authority_to_approve_exception: ROLE_WORKSTREAM_OWNER if not preparer, otherwise ROLE_DEAL_LEAD or specialist reviewer.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: approve model basis; approve valuation basis
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: A model or valuation becomes decision-ready.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Model owner is the sole reviewer and approver of the same version.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.authority_to_approve_exception: ROLE_DEAL_LEAD or governance authority under model-review policy.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: recommend investment; approve investment; commit capital
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: A recommendation leads to an investment or capital action.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Recommendation is treated as approval or capital authorization.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: None; separate explicit authority action required.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.record_created: Separate recommendation approval and capital approval records.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: administer policy; assign role; approve investment; commit capital; override blocker
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Technical administration grants content permission or investment authority by default.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: Break-glass content access may be time-bounded; it never grants investment authority.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.record_created: ENT_ACCESS_GRANT and audit event; no investment approval record.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: confirm legal condition; accept residual economic risk
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: A material legal issue affects a gate.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Business authority declares legal condition satisfied without legal evidence; legal reviewer commits capital.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: Business authority may accept quantified residual risk after legal finding, if the condition is waivable.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.record_created: Legal finding, ENT_RISK_ACCEPTANCE_RECORD, ENT_APPROVAL_RECORD, and possibly ENT_EXCEPTION_RECORD.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.expiry_rule: Acceptance expires on evidence or term change.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: confirm tax treatment; accept tax trade-off
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: Tax treatment and economic risk differ.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Tax specialist authorizes investment; business authority changes technical conclusion.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: Investment authority may accept quantified residual economics after technical opinion.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.expiry_rule: Reopens on structure, jurisdiction, or law change.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.affected_actions: commit capital; release funds; execute payment
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: A capital event is committed or funded.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.prohibited_combination: Funding operator is sole capital authorizer or authorizer executes without operational verification.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: Dual control under configured emergency procedure with independent post-review.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.record_created: ENT_APPROVAL_RECORD, ENT_CAPITAL_EVENT, and ENT_EXCEPTION_RECORD if emergency override.

delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.condition: Delegation does not expressly permit subdelegation.
delegation_conflict_and_sod_rules.permitted_exception: New delegation by the original authority only.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Permission is granted.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: grantee; scope; actions; confidentiality; effective_from; expires_at; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: grant_id; grantee; scope; effective_from; created_at
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Status becomes expired or revoked; historical grant remains.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor grant replaces scope without deleting prior grant.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Permission request is denied.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: grantee; requested_scope; status=denied; rationale
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: grant_id; grantee; requested_scope; decision_time
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: No expiry unless request is resubmitted.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: A later grant is a separate successor record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: A sensitive action requests permission evaluation.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: policy_version; actor_or_role; object; action; context; result; rationale; evaluated_at
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Evaluation is point-in-time and does not mutate.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: A new action or changed context creates a new evaluation.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority approves an action or object.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: authority_rule_id; subject; approver_roles; decision=approved; effective_at; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: approval_id; rule; subject; approvers; decision; effective_at; evidence snapshot
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: May lapse under attached conditions or rule; record remains immutable.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor approval links to prior record and marks prior superseded if appropriate.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority rejects an action or object.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: authority_rule_id; subject; approver_roles; decision=rejected; effective_at
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all decision fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: No automatic expiry.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: A later approval is a successor, not an edit.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority defers a decision.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: decision_type; decision=deferred; condition_set; decision_date; approval_record_ids
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: decision identity; date; basis; conditions; approvals
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Expires at next-review date or condition deadline.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor decision resolves or extends deferral.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority grants approval subject to explicit conditions.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: decision=conditional; conditions; effective_at; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: approval identity; rule; approvers; conditions; effective_at
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Lapses on condition deadline or material change.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Condition change requires successor approval.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority waives a gate or condition.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: subject; reason; scope; effect; approval_record_id; expires_at; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: exception identity; subject; reason; scope; approver; effective_at
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Expires at stated date, event, or changed evidence.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Extension or changed scope creates successor exception.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority overrides a blocker or materiality result.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: subject; reason; scope; effect; approval_record_id; expires_at; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: exception identity; subject; reason; scope; approval
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Expires at stated date or context change.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: New override creates successor record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority accepts residual risk or unresolved question.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: risk_or_question; scope; rationale; accepted_by_approval; review_or_expiry_date; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: record identity; subject; scope; rationale; approval; effective time
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Expires or reopens on review date, trigger, or material evidence change.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor acceptance links to prior acceptance.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authority is delegated for a scoped period.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: actor; role; scope; effective_from; effective_to; status; delegation_source
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: assignment identity; delegate; scope; time window; delegator
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Automatically expires or is revoked.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: New assignment supersedes or replaces scope.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: A conflict requires an actor to withdraw from an authority process.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: actor; role_assignment; subject; conflict_basis; effective_at; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Ends only by explicit resolution or process completion.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor resolution record closes recusal.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: An eligible participant records disagreement with a collective decision.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: actor; decision; dissent_text; basis_refs; recorded_at
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: No expiry.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Clarification appends a successor note; original remains.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authorized capital commitment is created.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: event_type; exposure; amount; currency; effective_date; status; approval
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: event identity; type; amount; currency; effective date; approval
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Unused commitment may expire under rule; historical commitment remains.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Amendment or cancellation creates a successor capital event.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Authorized funds are released.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: event_type; amount; currency; effective_date; status; approval; funds_flow
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: event identity; amount; currency; date; approval; instructions snapshot
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: No expiry after execution; failed release is separately recorded.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Correction creates a new capital event and reconciliation link.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: An authority-dependent workflow transition is authorized.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: authority_rule_id; subject=gate_or_transition; approvers; decision; effective_at
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: approval identity; rule version; transition; approvers; decision
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Lapses when gate, evidence, conditions, or rule changes.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Reapproval creates successor record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: A state, blocker, rule, or process exception is requested or approved.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: subject; reason; scope; effect; approval; status
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: exception identity; subject; reason; scope; approval
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Expires on date, event, or context change.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor exception required for changes.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: An approval or authority basis is superseded.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: subject; successor_reference; effective_at; status=superseded
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: prior identity; successor link; effective time
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Permanent historical status.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Successor remains separate.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: A permission-sensitive action is requested.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: policy_id; policy_version; role_assignment_id; object_entity_id; action; result; evaluated_at; workflow_event_id
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Re-evaluate when policy, role, object sensitivity, relationship, or action scope changes.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: A later evaluation is a separate record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Scoped authority is delegated.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: delegator; delegate; authority actions; scope; effective_at; expires_at; approval_record_id; workflow_event_id
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields except status
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Expires automatically or is explicitly revoked.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Scope changes require a successor delegation.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: A conflict requires removal from review, approval, or quorum.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: role_assignment_id; subject_entity_id; reason; scope; effective_at; workflow_event_id
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Ends only under the recorded scope or successor action.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Changes require a successor record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: A participant records a reasoned disagreement.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: decision_record_id; role_assignment_id; statement; recorded_at
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: No silent expiry.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: A clarification or withdrawal creates a successor record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: An approval, gate, execution, funding, or outcome action is conditional.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: subject_entity_id; condition_type; description; status; created_at
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: identity and condition definition
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Condition may expire or fail under its explicit rule.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Changed condition requires a successor record.

governance_record_contracts.triggering_action: Any controlled state, transition, workstream, permission, or authority event occurs.
governance_record_contracts.required_fields: deal_id; event_type; subject_entity_id; occurred_at; actor_role_assignment_id; idempotency_key
governance_record_contracts.immutable_fields: all fields
governance_record_contracts.expiry_behavior: Never expires.
governance_record_contracts.supersession_behavior: Never overwritten.

product_behaviors.trigger: Any actor requests a controlled action.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Evaluate active policy, access grant, role scope, object sensitivity, purpose, and expiry.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Allow, deny, condition, or request approval; never infer permission from role name alone.
product_behaviors.immutable_record_created: Permission evaluation record when available; access grant for grant/denial.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Requester and object owner on denial or approval request.

product_behaviors.trigger: An approval, waiver, risk acceptance, override, transition, or capital action is requested.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Request explicit authority action and validate the active rule and role assignments.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block until an effective immutable authority record exists.

product_behaviors.trigger: Time elapses, materials circulate, comments cease, or a meeting occurs.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Take no authority action.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: State and gate remain unchanged.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Responsible owner may receive a pending-action reminder.

product_behaviors.trigger: A materiality assessment returns block, trigger, or reopen.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Block or reopen the linked gate/workstream and request evidence or authority action.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block, reopen, stale, or escalate exactly as the assessment states.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Workstream owner, deal lead, and applicable authority.

product_behaviors.trigger: Continuation is proposed with material unresolved risk.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Request residual-risk statement and eligible risk-acceptance authority.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block until effective acceptance or issue resolution; reopen on expiry/change.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Risk owner, approver, and downstream consumers.

product_behaviors.trigger: A waivable condition or blocker is proposed for override.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Validate waivability, materiality, evidence, authority, scope, and expiry.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Permit only within explicit scope; otherwise deny.

product_behaviors.trigger: A relevant conflict is declared or detected.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Prevent participation in the affected authority action and request recusal.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Recalculate eligible approvers and quorum.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Conflicted actor, chair, and governance reviewer.

product_behaviors.trigger: The same actor is preparer and sole approver where separation is required.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Prevent self-approval and request independent reviewer/approver.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block authority action.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Preparer, accountable owner, and governance reviewer.

product_behaviors.trigger: A delegated authority assignment expires or is revoked.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Expire delegated capability immediately and re-evaluate pending actions.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Deny further delegated actions; reassign pending approvals.

product_behaviors.trigger: Collective authority lacks eligible quorum.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Block voting and request substitute or rescheduling under the rule.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: No decision may become effective.
product_behaviors.immutable_record_created: ENT_WORKFLOW_EVENT; ENT_APPROVAL_RECORD is created only after valid quorum.

product_behaviors.trigger: Authority issues conditional approval.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Create explicit conditions with owner, due date, satisfaction evidence, and waiver route.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block dependent transition until all conditions are satisfied or validly waived.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Condition owners, deal lead, and approvers.

product_behaviors.trigger: Approval validity condition, deadline, or basis changes.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Mark authority as lapsed/superseded for prospective use and request reapproval.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block dependent action.

product_behaviors.trigger: A later action differs from an earlier action.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Create successor records and preserve prior evidence, rule version, conditions, and dissent.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Never overwrite historical authority basis.

product_behaviors.trigger: An actor requests external sharing, disclosure, or export.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Evaluate recipient, purpose, source restrictions, confidentiality, legal basis, and approval requirement.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Deny, condition, or require approval.
product_behaviors.immutable_record_created: Permission evaluation and, if granted, scoped access/disclosure record.

product_behaviors.trigger: A system administrator modifies identity or policy configuration.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Apply change control, dual review where configured, and audit logging.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: No investment authority or content access is conferred.

product_behaviors.trigger: A capital event is committed or funded.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Require separate capital authorization, operational execution, and reconciliation.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Block funds release until all controls pass.
product_behaviors.affected_actor_notification: Capital authority, funding operator, and reconciliation owner.

product_behaviors.trigger: An eligible authority participant disagrees with a collective outcome.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Permit dissent to be recorded without changing the authority outcome.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Preserve dissent with decision basis.

product_behaviors.trigger: An object becomes more restricted due to new evidence, privilege, or source condition.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Re-evaluate inherited permissions and revoke incompatible grants prospectively.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Deny incompatible use and notify downstream users.
product_behaviors.immutable_record_created: Permission evaluation and updated policy/access grant.

product_behaviors.trigger: A material analytical object supporting an authority action becomes stale before action.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Block or reopen the action and request recomputation or explicit exception.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Authority cannot rely on stale material basis without recorded exception.
product_behaviors.immutable_record_created: ENT_EXCEPTION_RECORD and approval if continuation is permitted.

product_behaviors.trigger: A terminated or stalled process is proposed for revival.
product_behaviors.product_behavior: Require explicit new basis, successor decision, and route selection.
product_behaviors.engine_consequence: Keep original termination immutable; resume only after authority action.

draft_vs_committed_rule.analytical_draft: Draft, reviewed, and approved analytical objects remain non-binding representations until a valid authority action references their immutable versions.
draft_vs_committed_rule.approved_not_committed: An investment approval authorizes the decision within its conditions but does not itself create a binding capital commitment unless the governing authority contract says so.
draft_vs_committed_rule.committed: A commitment exists only after the applicable capital-commitment authority action succeeds and the ENT_DECISION_RECORD.commitment_status becomes committed through an immutable governance event.
draft_vs_committed_rule.funding_release: Release of funds is a separate authority action and execution record; permission to administer funding does not authorize commitment.
